name: What is the difference between vinyl, wood, and fiberglass windows?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between vinyl, wood, and fiberglass windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vinyl windows are a popular, cost-effective choice known for their low maintenance and good insulation properties. Wood windows offer a classic aesthetic, excellent insulation, and can be stained or painted, but require more maintenance. Fiberglass windows are durable, stable, energy-efficient, and resistant to warping or rotting, making them a premium, long-lasting option. Each material has distinct advantages regarding appearance, cost, and longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Vinyl windows are affordable and low-maintenance. Wood windows offer classic beauty and good insulation but need more upkeep. Fiberglass windows are durable, energy-efficient, and resistant to warping.
